A '''Twi'lek''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master, the bonds, they're too heavy|The Twi'lek|<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>}}
Sometime around or before [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] had become a slave of the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]]. He was walking across the Zygerrian market when he collapsed due to his heavy bonds. [[Atai Molec/Legends|A slaver]] ordered him up, paying no heed to the Twi'lek's complains about the bonds. The slaver was about to whip the Twi'lek using his [[shock whip]] but was stopped by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who was dressed as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] in order to [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|uncover a mystery]].
